metadata.purpose: Maintain shared project context for ChatGPT and Codex development.
metadata.source_of_truth: Actual repository source code, configuration, and reproducible test results.
metadata.status_note: This document records project architecture, development decisions, and known issues. Implementation and testing claims must be verified against the active repository.

project.name: Cognitive Robotic Arm
project.primary_research_focus: Robot arm motion planning and dynamic obstacle avoidance.
project.supporting_capability: Visual perception provides human geometry for motion planning and collision checking.
project.research_title_recommended: Perencanaan Gerak Lengan Robot dengan Penghindaran Rintangan Dinamis Berbasis Persepsi Visual Menggunakan GNG dan A*

workspace_planning.description: Previous planning implementation. Some functionality has already been migrated into src/planning/.
workspace_planning.development_policy: Do not modify, reuse, or migrate legacy code unless explicitly requested.

development_principles: Keep source code simple, readable, and maintainable.
Preserve the existing GNG and A* planning architecture.
Inspect actual source code before modifying it.
Preserve existing functionality and public interfaces.
Avoid unnecessary dependencies, classes, and files.
Verify ROS 2 interfaces and coordinate transformations.
Distinguish implemented, tested, in-progress, planned, and unverified features.
Never claim tests passed unless they were actually executed.
Do not assume previously discussed changes have been applied to the repository.
Document significant changes and verification results.

research_context.main_problem: Robot arm motion planning in environments containing dynamic obstacles represented through visual perception.
research_context.scope_caution: Dynamic obstacle avoidance must not be considered experimentally validated until the complete Vision, Planning, Motion, and Simulation pipeline has been tested.

overview: Vision detects humans and reconstructs human geometry.
Human geometry is published through ROS 2.
Planning receives and validates human obstacle information.
GNG provides the workspace-based graph representation.
A* performs path search in joint space.
Collision checking validates robot configurations and paths.
PlanningManager handles environment updates and planning decisions.

vision.role: Detect humans and generate geometric representations for Planning.
known_limitations: Capsule radius may be excessively large.
Radius estimates may fluctuate between frames.
Skeleton position noise may affect capsule endpoints.
Depth noise and voxel assignment may affect radius estimation.
Radius measurement quality is not directly exposed through HumanCapsule.msg.

planning.role: Generate and validate robot-arm paths using GNG and A*.

gng.role: Learn a graph representation from sampled robot workspace data.

joint_graph.role: Represent robot joint configurations and graph connectivity.

a_star.role: Search for a path through joint-space graph configurations.

collision_filter.role: Validate robot configurations, motion edges, and paths against obstacles.
collision_filter.status: Implemented; recent modifications require repository verification.

path_planner.role: Coordinate path search and path validation.

planning_manager.role: Manage planning decisions, environment changes, path validity, and execution coordination.

human_capsule_monitor.role: Validate incoming human geometry and monitor data freshness.

architecture_policy: Do not replace the planning architecture without technical justification.
Validate relevant robot links, not only the end-effector.
Revalidate paths when relevant obstacle geometry changes.

simulation.role: Simulate the robotic arm, obstacles, and trajectory execution.

ros_interfaces.verification_note: Topic names and message types are based on the previously inspected repository snapshot. Confirm them against the active source code and runtime ROS 2 graph.

coordinate_frames.known_issue: Human geometry and MuJoCo robot geometry may require an additional coordinate transformation before collision checking.
verification_required: Verify rotation and translation between frames.
Test collision calculations with controlled geometry.

human_obstacle_data.important_note: An empty detection result must not automatically be interpreted as a safe workspace without verified sensor coverage.

existing_human_collision_approach.robot_representation: MuJoCo collision geometries approximated using bounding spheres.
existing_human_collision_approach.distance_method: Point-to-segment distance adjusted by robot and human radii.
existing_human_collision_approach.limitation: Bounding sphere approximations may overestimate occupied space, especially for elongated robot links.

current_debugging_focus: Determine causes of invalid robot configurations.
development_policy: Preserve the existing CollisionFilter public interface.
Do not remove whole-arm collision checking.
Do not reduce collision margins without geometric justification.
Validate collision changes with controlled test cases.

vision_reconstruction.parameter_status: Proposed experimental configuration. Confirm that the active local YAML uses these values.

radius_estimation.default_radius: Minimum radius estimate for each body segment.
radius_estimation.maximum_radius: Upper bound for each segment radius.
radius_estimation.safety_margin: Additional radius margin applied during Vision reconstruction.

radius_filtering.previous_behavior: Radius increases immediately and decreases gradually.
radius_filtering.proposed_behavior: Asymmetric smoothing for radius increases and decreases.
radius_filtering.verification_status: Implementation prepared; runtime behavior not yet verified.

known_limitations: Radius defaults may dominate the voxel-based estimate.
Depth noise can influence voxel distribution.
Skeleton noise may affect capsule placement.
Temporal filtering may introduce measurement lag.
Coverage evaluation is required before reducing capsule dimensions.

simulation_preferences.change_policy: Do not modify these values unless explicitly requested.
limitations: Unknown human data may be ignored according to the Planning implementation.
This behavior is not evidence that the human workspace is clear.
Human avoidance must be evaluated with valid human geometry.
These settings are not certified for physical human-robot interaction.

current_development_focus.topic: Debugging Vision and Planning integration for human obstacle avoidance.
reported_problems: Path planning frequently fails when human obstacles are active.
Human capsule radius appears excessively large.
Human capsule dimensions fluctuate between frames.
Collision checking may classify too many configurations as invalid.
Small geometry changes may trigger repeated environment updates.
current_development_focus.objective: Improve geometric accuracy and stability while preserving the existing GNG and A* architecture.

changes: Use interpolation for voxel distance percentiles.
Reduce immediate radius expansion from noisy measurements.
Preserve previous radius when measurements are insufficient.

recent_development.important_note: Changes were discussed and prepared through ChatGPT. Their installation in the active local repository has not been independently verified.

in_progress: Dynamic path revalidation and replanning verification
not_yet_verified: Complete ROS 2 build after recent changes
Path planning success rate with human obstacles

known_risks_and_unresolved_issues.next_action: Verify transforms with controlled reference points.

known_risks_and_unresolved_issues.issue: Path planning failure with human obstacles
known_risks_and_unresolved_issues.description: Planning frequently fails when human obstacles are detected.
known_risks_and_unresolved_issues.next_action: Inspect failure statuses and collision diagnostics.

known_risks_and_unresolved_issues.description: Human capsule radii may fluctuate due to skeleton, depth, and voxel measurement noise.
known_risks_and_unresolved_issues.next_action: Evaluate updated radius filtering in RViz.

known_risks_and_unresolved_issues.description: Robot bounding sphere approximations may overestimate collision regions.
known_risks_and_unresolved_issues.next_action: Compare calculated collision distances with MuJoCo geometry.

known_risks_and_unresolved_issues.description: Small human geometry changes may repeatedly invalidate cached collision results.
known_risks_and_unresolved_issues.next_action: Measure update frequency and evaluate replanning behavior.

known_risks_and_unresolved_issues.description: The complete behavior of path invalidation, stopping, replanning, and motion resumption has not been verified after recent changes.
Previous development notes reported inconsistent trajectory tracking.
known_risks_and_unresolved_issues.next_action: Evaluate tracking errors after planning integration is validated.
